subject: Constraining covariances between two endogenous latent variables in SEM

messages.author: 8acbcba9d724d938
messages.subject: Constraining covariances between two endogenous latent variables in SEM
parts:
Hello,


I have the following model specified for lavaan sem() modelt fitting.


model.hyp <- '

# latent variables

F1 =~  x1+ x2+ x3+ x4

F2 =~ x5+ x6+ x7+ x8

F3 =~  x9+ x10+ x11+ x12+ x13+ x14

F4 =~   x15+ x16+ x17+ x18

 

# Covariance constraints

F3 ~~ 0*F4

 

# Regressions

F3~ F1+ F2

F4  ~ F1+ F2

'

 

My hypothesis implies the zero covariance between endogenous latent variables F3 and F4. By constraining the covariance to be zero between those two latent variables – am I constraining the residual variances to not covary or am I constraining latent variables F3 and F4 to not covary (as is my current thinking)?


With Best Regards,

M.M.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Constraining covariances between two endogenous latent variables in SEM
parts: am I constraining the residual variances to not covary
or am I constraining latent variables F3 and F4 to not covary (as is my current thinking)?

That is incorrect.  F3 and F4 must covary if they have a common cause (i.e., F1 and F2)
